spec._comment: R5 PARITY CHECK (2026-10-16): bare OpenHands 1.1.0 default agent, 10 iterations, temperature 0, ONE run per question (the paper's protocol), same judge as the main batch (claude-sonnet-4-5 x5 majority, 1-20 x5 = 100). Purpose: show this pipeline reproduces the published Table 3 OpenHands row for a paper model before AOCI is added. Acceptance band: merged 15-repo mean within 3 points of the paper's number and all five dimensions in the same direction; outside the band -> investigate (iteration cap, SDK version, reasoning parameters, provider precision) before any main-batch claim. No AOCI, no CodeGraph in this run. Model: GLM-4.6 via OpenRouter pinned to Novita bf16; paper Table 3 OpenHands 70.15.
